relations.subject: White Rabbit
relations.evidence: The Duchess! The Duchess! Oh my dear paws! Oh my fur and whiskers! She’ll get me executed, as sure as ferrets are ferrets!

relations.subject: Alice

relations.subject: Bill the Lizard
relations.evidence: Bill’s to go down—Here, Bill! the master says you’re to go down the chimney!

relations.subject: Mary Ann
relations.evidence: Why, Mary Ann, what are you doing out here? Run home this moment, and fetch me a pair of gloves and a fan!

relations.subject: White Rabbit
relations.evidence: she came upon a neat little house, on the door of which was a bright brass plate with the name “W. RABBIT,” engraved upon it

relations.subject: Alice
relations.evidence: She went in without knocking, and hurried upstairs
